arguments.text: 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: even shaft power near the sustainable level (~163-166 W pod; CP pod 160 W, reserve 16.4 kJ, both maybe 10-25% off) and spend the reserve by the finish; final push from ~1500 m left, finish sprint ~400 m. Do not chase ground pace (current flips with direction). Watch for: weed (speed per watt drops mid-leg, back-stroke fixes), pod drift (pod power vs heart rate / boat power disagree), CP wrong (heart rate keeps climbing at steady effort = above true CP; flat = below). Use heart-rate trend at steady effort to test CP; consider a test piece mid-race if unclear. Radio messages may change course length.

arguments.text: t=730s POD DRIFT: pod reading fell ~19% (166->135 W) over 610-700 s; boat power, speed thru water and HR unchanged/rising. Set pod_gain 0.81 since 655 s. too_easy alert at 727 s was false (drift). Before drift, boat/pod ratio was 0.68; watch ratio for further drift (or weed: ratio falls with HR flat). True effort now ~169 W pod-equivalent, HR creeping ~0.8 bpm/min => slightly above CP.

arguments.text: 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (out = north, current/wind +0.2 m/s helps out, hurts back). Hold even effort ~163-166 W pod (corrected, gain 0.81 since 655 s; CP belief 162). Pod reserve ~19% at 900 s. Final push from ~1500 m left, finish sprint ~400 m. Do not chase ground pace. Incidents so far: pod drifted low (corrected), weed on rudder at ~795 s cleared by back-stroke at ~845 s (speed back to ~3.18-3.21 out). Watch: HR slope at steady effort (0.7 bpm/min at 166 W => maybe slightly over CP), more weed (speed drop at same pod, mid-leg), further pod drift (pod vs boat-model ratio 0.68), radio messages (course length).
